posts.subject: Resetting your overall score!
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello to the Dream community! :'D


I would like to make a suggestion, and that is to be able to reset your WHOLE rank. This is not to be confused with !rs (which resets your rank for the current game) but resetting your whole score (your kill death ratio, kills, deaths, rank etc - basically start over again at the server).


A few people have requested this and I think it's a good idea for those who wants to reset thier score! :'D


Thank you, Doo Doo [thanksforit*] [thanksforit*]

Hello!
Juzo here. I'm one of the "requesters".


I think that the idea of a resetting score system is great. Knife can sometimes get a bit dull since you're practically doing the same thing over and over again, and after a while you get placed at a rank that barely ever changes. You just linger on the same spot in the ranks and your kill-to-death ratio barley move as well. But knife becomes much more refreshing if you're given a new chance to start over.


But i believe that it should be a feature that only the administrators or any other authority figure should possess. I would suggest that the player has to ask an administrator for it and give cogent and convincing reasons to why you should have it reset to prevent potential abuse. It can be along the lines of "I'm quite dissatisfied about my current kill-to-death ratio, I know that I'm able to keep a much higher one but since I've played here for ages my kill-to-death ratio is never going up!"


The rank system would get bent backwards if everyone could do it how much they want, e.g. The n1 player on the server is all of a sudden on the starting points. Now no one wants to face him because the probability of you killing him is very low, and if you get killed by him you lose loads of points since he's now a much lower rank than you, its similar to smurfing. A much more developed player sets himself on the same level as worse players to deliberately wreak havoc on their ranks.


Sincerely Juzo
Thanks for taking your time to read this submission, it's greatly appreciated [suchten*]

Zitat von Juzo

You should be able to reset your overall score as it helps you to start from the beginning and you would not have to worry when you check your K/D ratio, but also agree with Juzo that admins should only be able to reset someone's score so it will not be abused on daily bases.

You're already able to ASK an Admin to reset your rank etc.
Though it may take a while for actions to be taken [;)]
